intro.fr: Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub EviVirus/Archipelago-FFPS, qui héberge l'APWorld de Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator.
text.en: The GitHub repository EviVirus/Archipelago-FFPS, home of the Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la version v1.0.0-pre1 (préversion), seule version parue au 21 octobre 2026.
text.en: Version v1.0.0-pre1 (pre-release) is released, the only one as of October 21, 2026.

text.fr: Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
